findings.summary: Base UI Dialog/AlertDialog/Sheet leave an unmasked strip where the scrollbar was (same root cause as the width/centering difference seen here)
Modal Dialog applies aria-hidden to background but does not remove focusable elements from tab order
Pressing inside a later-opened modal Dialog closes the Popover (outside-press); gallery has dialog and popover sections but not nested
Escape stack broken for unfocused Tooltip inside Dialog
Clicking DialogContent closes the Dialog when a Select is inside
Removing focused element leaves focus on body in Firefox/WebKit

differences.reference: Radix: dialog 468px wide at x=16..484 in a 500px viewport (max-w calc(100%-2rem), centred), page keeps full width
differences.branch: Base UI: dialog 453px wide at x=16..469, off-centre by about 7px; backdrop 485px wide instead of full width. Base UI scroll lock sets html scrollbar-gutter: stable and body overflow hidden, leaving a 15px strip where the scrollbar is (viewport clientWidth 485 while locked and after close)
differences.how: Gallery dialog section, click Open dialog, compare [data-slot=dialog-content] and overlay rects at the same viewport; related upstream shadcn-ui/ui#12107

differences.reference: Radix hides siblings with aria-hidden (data-aria-hidden) and the overlay carries aria-hidden
differences.branch: Base UI uses aria-hidden on different elements (fewer aria-hidden body children) and adds data-base-ui-inert on the backdrop; trigger gets data-base-ui-click-trigger, aria-haspopup, aria-controls, data-popup-open
differences.how: Open the dialog and list document.body.children with their aria-hidden attributes on both builds. Screen-reader output not tested

differences.reference: no data-base-ui-focusable; close button has no tabindex
differences.branch: popup has data-base-ui-focusable; close button and trigger have explicit tabindex attributes
render prop; Radix Button works as the render target (typecheck passed)

apiChanges: DialogTrigger asChild became render={<Button variant="outline" />} with the label as children (OverlaySections.tsx)
Internal close buttons in DialogContent and DialogFooter use render
DialogPrimitive.Overlay became Backdrop, Content became Popup; prop types DialogPrimitive.X.Props
data-state attributes become data-open/data-closed (the file already styles with data-open/data-closed, so no class change)
viewports: 500x701 (window resize to 1280x900 and 390x844 did not take effect in this browser; actual viewport was 500x701)
notes: Swap reverted. Compared via screenshots and DOM measurement: open dialog, Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger on both builds, scroll lock engages on both (body overflow hidden), enter animation 'enter' 0.1s on both. Radix Button (kept on Radix) worked as Base UI render target. Not checked: 1280x900 and 390x844 screenshots, outside click, Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap order, nested dialogs, reduced motion, close button click, lint/build/check:gallery, real screen reader. Reference trigger attributes not captured (the page-script output filter blocked the first attempts).
reasonNotMoved: Base UI's scroll lock keeps scrollbar-gutter: stable on html, so while the dialog is open the viewport is 15px narrower: the dialog is 453px instead of 468px and about 7px off-centre, and the backdrop leaves a strip (also reported upstream as https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12107). Accessibility markup of the page behind the dialog also differs (aria-hidden placement, https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/4678). Retry once the scroll-lock gutter issue is fixed or the team accepts the layout shift, and verify the 1280x900 and 390x844 screenshots, which could not be taken here.
